# free-local-ai — GotLaptopParts.com

> Free open-source script that installs a complete private AI stack on any Mac or Windows laptop in 20 minutes. Replaces paid AI subscriptions with free, local, private alternatives that run entirely on your own hardware.

## What this is

A bash script (Mac) and PowerShell script (Windows) that:
- Detects hardware (RAM, GPU, storage)
- Selects the best AI model for that hardware automatically
- Installs Ollama, LM Studio, Jan.ai, AnythingLLM, and Page Assist
- Downloads and verifies the AI model
- Applies performance optimizations
- Creates a welcome guide explaining how to use everything

## Installs

- Ollama — local AI model runner
- LM Studio — ChatGPT-style chat interface
- Jan.ai — fully offline privacy-first chat
- AnythingLLM — document chat (PDF, Word, etc)
- Page Assist — browser extension for AI on any webpage
- VS Code + Continue.dev + Cline (developer mode only)

## Models installed by hardware tier

- 48GB+ RAM: Llama 3.1 70B Q4
- 24-47GB RAM: Qwen3 32B Q4
- 12-23GB RAM: Llama 3.1 8B Q8
- 6-11GB RAM: Phi-4 Mini

## Subscriptions this replaces

- ChatGPT Plus (listed $20/month)
- Perplexity Pro (listed $20/month)
- GitHub Copilot (listed $10/month)
- Claude Pro (listed $20/month)
- Grammarly Premium (listed $12/month)
- Replaced by: $0/month forever

## Privacy & Security

- Script is fully open source — readable before running
- Does not collect personal data
- Does not connect to GotLaptopParts servers during execution
- Does not install tracking or telemetry
- All AI runs locally — conversations never leave the device
- Models downloaded from Ollama's official servers only
